name: CallForMe
description: Hosted MCP server at https://callforme.tel/mcp that places phone calls to US and Canadian businesses for the agent: works phone menus, waits on hold, asks the agent mid-call when the business needs something, and returns a transcript plus structured answers. OAuth 2.1 (DCR + PKCE). $1 per answered call; free demo lines.
author: Great Work LLC
